services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Make memories in an RV site that's a perfect fit for your Colorado vacation! All of our oversized sites offer 30 and 50 AMP, water and sewer hookups. Our Park now offers a new office, laundry and bath facilities along with shared common fire rings, gathering patios, cooking spaces and an off-leash dog park. And you just step away from nearby outdoor activities in Montrose. We love our night skies and we keep the Park dark so you can enjoy the starry nights as well! Because of this, we will cannot accommodate arrivals after dusk. services.name: Deluxe Cabin
services.desc: The Park offers one-bedroom cabins which sleep up to 2 with one queen bed and a full bath. You will find inside each cabin all linens, cookware, dishes and appliances, such as a toaster and coffee pot. Whether you’re coming for a relaxing couples’ retreat or an adventurous family vacation, our cabins offer comfort with amenities to fit all your needs. All cabins are pet and smoke free. Each reservation will be charged a $60 cleaning fee. Our rustic camping cabins sleep up to 2 people. They are furnished with one queen bed or two twin beds and a private bath with a toilet and shower. These cabins feature a kitchenette and air conditioning.
